review.rationale: WEB.40 successor of web-40-admission-r6 for the deploy switch (unit U3b). .github/workflows/ci.yml: the candidate job publishes the Blazor WebAssembly application, emits the Worker and build identity through tooling/candidate.ts, builds the sealed C# candidate twice with a byte comparison, verifies it, and builds the Account and Chat profile bundle with the C# tool; the deploy job restores and builds the C# verifier and then ships the same sealed candidate under the unchanged main-push guards. The static Site candidate is the C# Site output. No package, lock, class, closure or project file changes; every other input digest is unchanged from r6.
review.runtimeAssessment: The workflow runs the locked restore and build of the candidate verifier and the Blazor WebAssembly publish, the sealed candidate build twice with a byte comparison and its verification, the profile bundle build and verification, and the deploy-time verification before the existing Cloudflare upload. No browser run, live service, hosted device or macOS job is added.
review.maintenance: Each NuGet coordinate is exact and content-hashed. The Contracts packages move only by a reviewed successor that re-verifies the CON.07 or later candidate identity from the publication record. The browser-wasm packs must stay at the SDK bundled runtime version (10.0.12 for SDK 10.0.401); any change needs a new reviewed receipt that names this file as its predecessor. Historical receipts remain immutable.
review.immutableHistory: Admitted review records are retained in Git history. A dependency change requires a new reviewed source commit and updated input-bound rationale; never amend an already accepted provenance record.

dependencyClasses.build-inputs: Complete exact npm lock inventory; licence metadata is preserved, not inferred as a redistribution grant. Existing transitive development prereleases are named build-only migration inputs and cannot enter runtime/stable closures.
dependencyClasses.runtime: Only the independently enforced existing shipped artifact records admit runtime inputs and legal scopes.
dependencyClasses.native: No new product native capability; existing tooling and Cloud base image/native runtime obligations remain with the exact artifact profiles.

publication.promotion: sealed candidate; existing provider identity verification; no registry tooling publication or credential in PR
